title: Exploring the cytotoxic potential of Artemisia herba-alba crude extract and key phytoconstituents using in vitro assays and molecular docking insights.
authors: Al-Halaseh, Lidia Kamal; Al-Samydai, Ali M; Moshawih, Said; Al-Qaraleh, Moath; Al-Zregat, Diana M; Amareen, Zaid S; Al Soub, Manal Nahar; Abdelhadi, Nadine N; Qaraghuli, Samra
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估植物提取物对癌细胞系的细胞毒性，并用分子对接考察小分子与癌症相关蛋白（非DNA）的结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The aim of the current research project is to evaluate the potential cytotoxicity of the aqueous extract of Artemisia -albaherba aerial parts against selected cancer cell lines. The widely grown plant material was collected and extracted. The crude aqueous extract was subjected to MTT analysis to assess potential cytotoxicity and cell viability. The cell lines utilized include: Normal Human Umbilical Vein Endothelial cell line EA (HUVEC; cat. no. CRL-1730; ATCC), Triple Negative Breast cancer cell line, MDA MB 231 (HTB-26), Human Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma cell line PANC1 (CRL-1469), Human Colorectal Carcinoma HCT 116 (CCL-247) cell lines. Cisplatin and doxorubicin serve as reference agents, and the media vehicle serves as a negative control. The extract was analysed by UHPLC/MS-MS. Three of the detected bioactive phytoconstituents, namely liquiritigenin, isofraxidin, and artemisinin, were docked against three cancer-associated protein targets corresponding to the three investigated cancer cell lines. The selected targets were TP53/p53 in the HCT-116 colorectal cancer cell line, AKT1 in the MDA cell line, and KRAS in the PANC-1 pancreatic cancer cell line. A marked decrease in cell viability was observed in the human colon and breast cancer cell lines at plant extract concentrations of 0.046-50 mg/mL. The highest cytotoxicity, around 45%, was observed against human colon cancer cells at concentrations of 12.5-50 mg/mL. And the cytotoxicity was around 40% against breast cancer cells at a concentration of 50 mg/mL. The plant remedy exhibited moderate cytotoxicity against pancreatic cancer cells, with an IC50 of approximately 20% at the highest tested concentration. The biocompatibility of the aqueous extract was predicted; hence, normal epithelial cells retained their viability at 1.5 mg/mL and showed a moderate-to-weak effect at higher concentrations. The herbal extract exhibits the highest IC50 values against EA and PANC1 of 220-240 microg/mL, whereas against MDA-MB-231 and HCT-116 cells, the IC50 values are significantly lower at 80-100 microg/mL. This indicates greater sensitivity of breast and colon cancer cell lines to the natural product. The simulation analyses demonstrate that isofraxidin and liquiritigenin have better binding affinity to the selected proteins than artemisinin. The best overall complexes were TP53-isofraxidin and TP53-liquiritigenin, with docking scores around -8 kcal/mol, followed by KRAS-liquiritigenin and AKT1-isofraxidin. To sum up, A. herb alba has a potential selective anticancer effect that may be attributed to the phenolic compounds constituents. These promising findings warrant further study to elucidate its mechanism of action, safety profile, and to predict the optimal dosage formulation.
abstract_zh: 本研究项目旨在评估白蒿（Artemisia herba-alba）地上部分水提物对选定癌细胞系的潜在细胞毒性。采集并提取了广泛生长的植物材料。将粗水提物进行MTT分析，以评估潜在细胞毒性和细胞活力。所用细胞系包括：正常人脐静脉内皮细胞系EA（HUVEC；目录号CRL-1730；ATCC）、三阴性乳腺癌细胞系MDA MB 231（HTB-26）、人胰腺导管腺癌细胞系PANC1（CRL-1469）、人结直肠癌细胞系HCT 116（CCL-247）。顺铂和阿霉素作为参考药物，培养基载体作为阴性对照。提取物通过UHPLC/MS-MS进行分析。检测到的三种生物活性植物成分，即甘草素（liquiritigenin）、异秦皮啶（isofraxidin）和青蒿素（artemisinin），分别与对应于三种所研究癌细胞系的三种癌症相关蛋白靶点进行分子对接。所选靶点为HCT-116结直肠癌细胞系中的TP53/p53、MDA细胞系中的AKT1以及PANC-1胰腺癌细胞系中的KRAS。在植物提取物浓度为0.046-50 mg/mL时，人结肠癌和乳腺癌细胞系中观察到细胞活力显著下降。在12.5-50 mg/mL浓度下，对人结肠癌细胞的细胞毒性最高，约为45%。在50 mg/mL浓度下，对乳腺癌细胞的细胞毒性约为40%。该植物药物对胰腺癌细胞表现出中等细胞毒性，在最高测试浓度下IC50约为20%。预测了水提物的生物相容性；因此，正常上皮细胞在1.5 mg/mL时保持活力，在更高浓度下表现出中至弱效应。该草药提取物对EA和PANC1的IC50值最高，为220-240微克/mL，而对MDA-MB-231和HCT-116细胞，IC50值显著较低，为80-100微克/mL。这表明乳腺癌和结肠癌细胞系对该天然产物具有更高的敏感性。模拟分析表明，异秦皮啶和甘草素对所选蛋白的结合亲和力优于青蒿素。总体最佳复合物为TP53-异秦皮啶和TP53-甘草素，对接分数约为-8 kcal/mol，其次是KRAS-甘草素和AKT1-异秦皮啶。总之，白蒿具有潜在的选择性抗癌作用，这可能归因于其酚类化合物成分。这些有前景的发现值得进一步研究，以阐明其作用机制、安全性特征，并预测最佳剂量配方。
